drona.face: Aged acharya-warrior, noble lined face, long white beard and mustache (guru in the garden, not a garden sage only)
drona.hair: White hair in a saffron-bound topknot, rudraksha — no Kuru silver diadem of Bhishma
drona.costume: Saffron angavastram over pale cream dhoti, staff or bow of the guru

arjuna.face: Noble warrior prince, dark mustache, same face as Ep 09 lock
arjuna.costume: Cream-white dhoti, gold belt, quiver on back, Gandiva — never flower garland, never peacock

yudhishthira.face: Eldest Pandava king-in-training, calm noble face, modest mustache — distinct from Arjuna, never a second Arjuna
yudhishthira.hair: Dark hair, simple gold diadem (lighter than Arjuna’s heavy crown), no peacock feather
yudhishthira.costume: Cream-white royal dhoti, gold sash, no Gandiva, no flower garland

armies.costume: Muted banners, equal human scale, no gore
